faq.q: What does the home evaluation on this page actually produce?
faq.a: A Comparative Market Analysis (CMA): Jared evaluates the prices of properties similar to yours that have recently sold in your area, giving you a better idea of your property's market value as a first step in preparing to sell.

faq.q: Which areas does Jared cover for home evaluations?
faq.a: The seven areas the page lists: South Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Abbotsford, Surrey, Tsawwassen and Ladner; the page invites anyone unsure their home is in one of them to call or text 604-928-1361.

faq.q: Does requesting an evaluation make me Jared's client?
faq.a: Under the BC framework BCFSA publishes, a licensee must disclose at the outset of dealings whether they can represent you as a client and what duties are owed to clients and non-clients — ask for that disclosure when the evaluation conversation starts.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
